# Villager News — Trigger and dialogue checklist

Companion to [the audit](REPORT.md). Confirmed decoded content from the byte-identical script. Titles and descriptions come from the handbook, not invented parity guarantees. All triggers are missing in active Crossrock gameplay. `C` confirms source occurrence, not proven reachability. Source symbol links locate the first occurrence; callbacks/predicates must be read at all symbol uses. Exact subtitle cue time/key/text and cooldown-tag payloads are included in inventory.json → dialogue_groups.
